map.Aw = 食品水蒸气压 ÷ 纯水蒸气压（0–1）；微生物生长阈值：Aw<0.60: Aw = food vapor pressure ÷ pure-water vapor pressure (0–1); microbial growth thresholds: below 0.60 most microbes do not grow, 0.60–0.85 yeasts/molds, above 0.85 bacteria can grow.…
map.Aw 和含水量一样吗？: Is Aw the same as water content?
map.不同。含水量是绝对水，Aw 是可供微生物利用的自由水，受糖盐束缚影响。: No. Water content is the absolute amount of water; Aw is the free water available to microbes and is affected by binding from sugars and salts.
map.脱水、加糖/盐降低自由水、用保湿剂（甘油/山梨醇）并配合防腐剂与包装。: Dehydrate, add sugar/salt to lower free water, use humectants (glycerol/sorbitol), and combine with preservatives and packaging.
